bhāṣya_and_rule.active: The kit/ṅit condition carried into 6.4.67 gives e in deyāt and dheyāt.
bhāṣya_and_rule.middle: The Kāśikā explicitly cites dāsīṣṭa and dhāsīṣṭa as controls retaining ā.

printed_and_electronic_mādhavīya.difference: Root vowel length. The second vowel ī is unchanged. The written primary agrees with the print and Kāśikā.

future_endings: In luṭ, 2.4.85 selects the same third-person forms in P and A. The second and first persons show the pada, e.g. dātāsi/dātāse, dhātāsmi/dhātāhe.
conditional: The augment is internal to the preverbs, so prā or parī is not inserted for lṛṅ; the sequences here begin praṇya-/pariṇya-.
